titles.ar: 89- بَابُ أَنّهُ يَجُوزُ أَن يُحِلّ الرّجُلُ جَارِيَتَهُ لِأَخِيهِ المُؤمِنِ
titles.en: 89- Chapter That It Is Permissible for a Man to Grant His Slave-Girl to His Believing Brother

titles.ar: 90- بَابُ حُكمِ وَلَدِ الجَارِيَةِ المُحَلّلَةِ
titles.en: 90- Chapter on the Ruling of the Child of a Permitted Slave-Girl

titles.ar: 91- بَابُ أَنّهُ يُرَاعَي فِي ذَلِكَ لَفظُ التّحلِيلِ دُونَ العَارِيّةِ
titles.en: 91- Chapter That the Wording of Permitting Must Be Considered, Not the Wording of Lending

titles.ar: 92- بَابُ تَحلِيلِ المُتعَةِ
titles.en: 92- Chapter on the Permissibility of Mut'a

titles.ar: 93- بَابُ أَنّهُ لَا ينَبغَيِ أَن يُتَمَتّعَ إِلّا بِالمُؤمِنَةِ العَارِفَةِ العَفِيفَةِ دُونَ المُخَالِفَةِ الفَاجِرَةِ
titles.en: 93- Chapter That One Should Not Engage in Mut'a Except with a Believing, Knowledgeable, Chaste Woman, Not with a Dissenting, Immoral One

titles.ar: 94- بَابُ التّمَتّعِ بِالأَبكَارِ
titles.en: 94- Chapter on Mut'a with Virgins

titles.ar: 95- بَابُ جَوَازِ التّمَتّعِ بِالإِمَاءِ
titles.en: 95- Chapter on the Permissibility of Mut'a with Slave-Women

titles.ar: 96- بَابُ أَنّهُ يَجُوزُ الجَمعُ بَينَ أَكثَرَ مِن أَربَعٍ فِي المُتعَةِ
titles.en: 96- Chapter That It Is Permissible to Combine More Than Four Women in Mut'a Marriage

titles.ar: 97- بَابُ جَوَازِ العَقدِ عَلَي المَرأَةِ مُتعَةً بِغَيرِ شُهُودٍ
titles.en: 97- Chapter on the Permissibility of Contracting Mut'a with a Woman Without Witnesses

titles.ar: 98- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا شُرِطَ ثُبُوتُ المِيرَاثِ فِي المُتعَةِ كَانَ ذَلِكَ جَائِزاً وَ وَاجِباً
titles.en: 98- Chapter That If Inheritance Is Stipulated as a Condition in Mut'a, It Is Permissible and Binding

titles.ar: 99- بَابُ مِقدَارِ مَا يجُزيِ مِن ذِكرِ الأَجَلِ فِي المُتعَةِ
titles.en: 99- Chapter on the Minimum Mention of the Term That Suffices in Mut'a

titles.ar: 100- بَابُ أَنّ وَلَدَ المُتعَةِ لَاحِقٌ بِأَبِيهِ
titles.en: 100- Chapter That the Child of a Mut'a Marriage Is Attributed to His Father

titles.ar: 101- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا كَانَ لِوَلَدِ الرّجُلِ الصّغِيرِ جَارِيَةٌ جَازَ لَهُ أَن يَطَأَهَا بَعدَ أَن يُقَوّمَهَا عَلَي نَفسِهِ
titles.en: 101- Chapter That If a Man's Minor Son Has a Slave-Girl, the Father May Have Intercourse with Her After Valuing Her Against Himself

titles.ar: 102- بَابُ أَنّهُ لَا يَجُوزُ العَقدُ عَلَي امرَأَةٍ عَقَدَ عَلَيهَا الأَبُ أَوِ الِابنُ وَ إِن لَم يَدخُل بِهَا
titles.en: 102- Chapter That One May Not Contract Marriage with a Woman Whom the Father or Son Has Contracted Marriage with, Even Without Consummation

titles.ar: 103- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا عَقَدَ الرّجُلُ عَلَي امرَأَةٍ حَرُمَت عَلَيهِ أُمّهَا وَ إِن لَم يَدخُل بِهَا
titles.en: 103- Chapter That If a Man Contracts Marriage with a Woman, Her Mother Becomes Forbidden to Him Even Without Consummation

titles.ar: 104- بَابُ أَنّ حُكمَ المَملُوكَةِ فِي هَذَا البَابِ حُكمُ الحُرّةِ
titles.en: 104- Chapter That the Ruling for a Slave-Woman in This Regard Is the Same as That for a Free Woman

titles.ar: 105- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا دَخَلَ بِالأُمّ حَرُمَت عَلَيهِ البِنتُ وَ إِن كَانَت مَملُوكَةً
titles.en: 105- Chapter That If He Has Consummated the Marriage with the Mother, the Daughter Becomes Forbidden to Him Even If She Is a Slave-Woman

titles.ar: 106- بَابُ حَدّ الدّخُولِ ألّذِي يَحرُمُ مَعَهُ نِكَاحُ الرّبِيبَةِ
titles.en: 106- Chapter on the Limit of Consummation That Makes Marriage to the Stepdaughter Forbidden

titles.ar: 107- بَابُ الرّجُلِ يزَنيِ بِالمَرأَةِ هَل يَحِلّ لِأَبِيهِ أَو لِابنِهِ أَن يَتَزَوّجَهَا أَم لَا أَو يَملِكُ الجَارِيَةَ فَيَطَؤُهَا الِابنُ قَبلَ أَن يَطَأَهَا الأَبُ هَل تَحرُمُ عَلَي الأَبِ أَم لَا
titles.en: 107- Chapter on a Man Who Commits Fornication with a Woman: May His Father or Son Marry Her, or May a Slave-Girl Be Owned by Him and His Son Has Intercourse with Her Before the Father: Does She Become Forbidden to the Father

titles.ar: 108- بَابُ الرّجُلِ يَفجُرُ بِالمَرأَةِ أَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَن يَتَزَوّجَ بِأُمّهَا أَوِ ابنَتِهَا أَم لَا
titles.en: 108- Chapter on a Man Who Commits Fornication with a Woman: May He Marry Her Mother or Daughter

titles.ar: 109- بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ العَقدِ عَلَي الفَاجِرَةِ
titles.en: 109- Chapter on the Dislikedness of Contracting Marriage with a Promiscuous Woman

titles.ar: 110- بَابُ الرّجُلِ يَعقِدُ عَلَي امرَأَةٍ ثُمّ يَعقِدُ عَلَي أُختِهَا وَ هُوَ لَا يَعلَمُ
titles.en: 110- Chapter on a Man Who Contracts Marriage with a Woman and Then Contracts Marriage with Her Sister Without Knowing

titles.ar: 111- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا طَلّقَ الرّجُلُ امرَأَتَهُ تَطلِيقَةً بَائِنَةً جَازَ لَهُ العَقدُ عَلَي أُختِهَا فِي الحَالِ
titles.en: 111- Chapter That If a Man Irrevocably Divorces His Wife, He May Immediately Contract Marriage with Her Sister

titles.ar: 112- بَابُ تَحرِيمِ الجَمعِ بَينَ الأُختَينِ فِي المُتعَةِ
titles.en: 112- Chapter on the Prohibition of Combining Two Sisters in Mut'a Marriage

titles.ar: 113- بَابُ النهّي ِ عَنِ الجَمعِ بَينَ الأُختَينِ فِي الوَطءِ بِمِلكِ اليَمِينِ
titles.en: 113- Chapter on the Prohibition of Combining Two Sisters in Intercourse Through Right of Ownership

titles.ar: 114- بَابُ الرّجُلِ يَتَزَوّجُ امرَأَةً هَل يَجُوزُ أَن يُزَوّجَ ابنَهُ ابنَتَهَا مِن غَيرِهِ أَم لَا
titles.en: 114- Chapter on a Man Who Marries a Woman: May He Marry His Son to Her Daughter from Another Man

titles.ar: 115- بَابُ تَزوِيجِ القَابِلَةِ
titles.en: 115- Chapter on the Marriage of a Midwife

titles.ar: 116- بَابُ نِكَاحِ المَرأَةِ عَلَي عَمّتِهَا وَ خَالَتِهَا
titles.en: 116- Chapter on Marriage with a Woman While Her Paternal or Maternal Aunt Is Already Married to Him

titles.ar: 117- بَابُ تَحرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الكَوَافِرِ مِن سَائِرِ أَصنَافِ الكُفّارِ
titles.en: 117- Chapter on the Prohibition of Marriage with Disbelieving Women of All Types of Disbelievers

titles.ar: 118- بَابُ الرّجُلِ وَ المَرأَةِ إِذَا كَانَا ذِمّيّينِ فَتُسلِمُ المَرأَةُ دُونَ الرّجُلِ
titles.en: 118- Chapter on a Man and Woman Who Are Both Dhimmis and the Woman Converts to Islam Without the Man

titles.ar: 119- بَابُ تَحرِيمِ نِكَاحِ النّاصِبَةِ المَشهُورَةِ بِذَلِكَ
titles.en: 119- Chapter on the Prohibition of Marriage with a Nasibiyya (One Known for Enmity to the Ahl al-Bayt)

titles.ar: 120- بَابُ مَن عَقَدَ عَلَي امرَأَةٍ فِي عِدّتِهَا مَعَ العِلمِ بِذَلِكَ
titles.en: 120- Chapter on One Who Contracts Marriage with a Woman During Her Waiting Period Knowing of It

titles.ar: 121- بَابُ أَنّهُ مَتَي دَخَلَ بِهَا الزّوجُ الثاّنيِ لَزِمَتهَا عِدّتَانِ
titles.en: 121- Chapter That Whenever the Second Husband Consummates the Marriage, She Must Observe Two Waiting Periods

titles.ar: 122- بَابُ الرّجُلِ يَتَزَوّجُ بِامرَأَةٍ ثُمّ عَلِمَ بَعدَ مَا دَخَلَ بِهَا أَنّ لَهَا زَوجاً
titles.en: 122- Chapter on a Man Who Marries a Woman and Then Discovers After Consummation That She Has a Husband

titles.ar: 123- بَابُ تَزوِيجِ المَرأَةِ فِي نِفَاسِهَا
titles.en: 123- Chapter on Marrying a Woman During Her Postpartum Period

titles.ar: 124- بَابُ تَزوِيجِ المَرِيضِ
titles.en: 124- Chapter on the Marriage of a Sick Person

titles.ar: 125- بَابُ مِقدَارِ مَا يُحَرّمُ مِنَ الرّضَاعِ
titles.en: 125- Chapter on the Minimum Amount of Breastfeeding That Causes Prohibition of Marriage

titles.ar: 126- بَابُ أَنّ اللّبَنَ لِلفَحلِ
titles.en: 126- Chapter That the Milk Belongs to the Man (i.e., the Father's Milk Establishes Prohibition)

titles.ar: 127- بَابُ أَنّ الوَلَدَ لَاحِقٌ بِالحُرّ مِنَ الأَبَوَينِ أَيّهُمَا كَانَ
titles.en: 127- Chapter That the Child Is Attributed to the Free Parent, Whichever of the Two Parents Is Free

titles.ar: 128- بَابُ أَنّ المَملُوكَ إِذَا كَانَ مُتَزَوّجاً بِحُرّةٍ كَانَ الطّلَاقُ بِيَدِهِ
titles.en: 128- Chapter That When a Slave Is Married to a Free Woman, Divorce Is in His Hands

titles.ar: 129- بَابُ أَنّ بَيعَ الأَمَةِ طَلَاقُهَا
titles.en: 129- Chapter That Selling a Slave-Woman Constitutes Her Divorce

titles.ar: 130- بَابُ مَن تَزَوّجَ أَمَةً عَلَي حُرّةٍ بِغَيرِ إِذنِهَا كَانَ عَلَيهِ التّعزِيرُ
titles.en: 130- Chapter on a Man Who Marries a Slave-Woman While Already Married to a Free Woman Without Her Permission: He Incurs a Disciplinary Punishment

titles.ar: 131- بَابُ أَنّ الرّجُلَ يُعتِقُ أَمَتَهُ وَ يَجعَلُ عِتقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا
titles.en: 131- Chapter on a Man Who Emancipates His Slave-Concubine and Makes Her Emancipation Her Mahr

titles.ar: 132- بَابُ مَا يُحَرّمُ جَارِيَةَ الأَبِ عَلَي الِابنِ أَو جَارِيَةَ الِابنِ عَلَي الأَبِ
titles.en: 132- Chapter on What Makes a Father's Slave-Girl Forbidden to His Son or a Son's Slave-Girl Forbidden to His Father

titles.ar: 133- بَابُ مَا يَحِلّ لِلمَملُوكِ مِنَ النّسَاءِ بِالعَقدِ
titles.en: 133- Chapter on What Women a Male Slave May Marry

titles.ar: 134- بَابُ أَنّ الرّجُلَ إِذَا زَوّجَ مَملُوكَتَهُ عَبدَهُ كَانَ الطّلَاقُ بِيَدِهِ وَ مَتَي طَلّقَ المَملُوكُ لَم يَقَع طَلَاقُهُ
titles.en: 134- Chapter That If a Man Marries His Slave-Woman to His Male Slave, Divorce Is in the Master's Hands, and If the Male Slave Pronounces Divorce, It Is Ineffective

titles.ar: 135- بَابُ الأَمَةِ تَزَوّجُ بِغَيرِ إِذنِ مَولَاهَا أَيّ شَيءٍ يَكُونُ حُكمُ الوَلَدِ
titles.en: 135- Chapter on a Slave-Woman Who Marries Without Her Master's Permission: What Is the Ruling Regarding the Child

titles.ar: 136- بَابُ أَنّهُ لَا يَجُوزُ العَقدُ عَلَي الإِمَاءِ إِلّا بِإِذنِ مَوَالِيهِنّ
titles.en: 136- Chapter That Slave-Women May Not Be Contracted in Marriage Without Their Masters' Permission

titles.ar: 137- بَابُ أَنّهُ يَجُوزُ الدّخُولُ بِالمَرأَةِ وَ إِن لَم يُقَدّم لَهَا مَهرُهَا
titles.en: 137- Chapter That It Is Permissible to Consummate the Marriage with a Woman Even If Her Mahr Has Not Been Paid in Advance

titles.ar: 138- بَابُ أَنّ الرّجُلَ إِذَا سَمّي المَهرَ وَ دَخَلَ بِالمَرأَةِ قَبلَ أَن يُعطِيَهَا مَهرَهَا كَانَ دَيناً عَلَيهِ
titles.en: 138- Chapter That If a Man Names the Mahr and Consummmates the Marriage Before Paying It, He Owes It as a Debt

titles.ar: 139- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا دَخَلَ بِالمَرأَةِ وَ لَم يُسَمّ لَهَا مَهراً كَانَ لَهَا مَهرُ المِثلِ
titles.en: 139- Chapter That If He Consummates the Marriage Without Naming a Mahr, She Is Entitled to the Standard Mahr

titles.ar: 140- بَابُ مَا يُوجِبُ المَهرَ كَامِلًا
titles.en: 140- Chapter on What Necessitates the Full Mahr

titles.ar: 141- بَابُ مَن تَزَوّجَ المَرأَةَ عَلَي حُكمِهَا فِي المَهرِ
titles.en: 141- Chapter on One Who Marries a Woman Leaving the Mahr to Her Discretion

titles.ar: 142- بَابُ مَن عَقَدَ عَلَي امرَأَةٍ وَ شَرَطَ لَهَا أَن لَا يَتَزَوّجَ عَلَيهَا وَ لَا يَتَسَرّي
titles.en: 142- Chapter on One Who Contracts Marriage with a Woman on the Condition That He Will Not Take Another Wife or Concubine

titles.ar: 143- بَابُ أَنّ الثّيّبَ ولَيِ ّ نَفسِهَا
titles.en: 143- Chapter That a Previously Married Woman Is Her Own Guardian

titles.ar: 144- بَابُ أَنّهُ لَا تَزَوّجُ البِكرُ إِلّا بِإِذنِ أَبِيهَا
titles.en: 144- Chapter That a Virgin May Not Be Married Except with Her Father's Permission

titles.ar: 145- بَابُ أَنّ الأَبَ إِذَا عَقَدَ عَلَي ابنَتِهِ الصّغِيرَةِ قَبلَ أَن تَبلُغَ لَم يَكُن لَهَا
titles.en: 145- Chapter That If a Father Contracts Marriage for His Minor Daughter Before She Reaches Maturity, She Has No Right of Objection

titles.ar: 146- بَابُ مَن يَعقِدُ عَلَي المَرأَةِ سِوَي أَبِيهَا
titles.en: 146- Chapter on Who Besides the Father May Contract Marriage on Behalf of a Woman

titles.ar: 147- بَابُ تَفضِيلِ بَعضِ النّسَاءِ عَلَي بَعضٍ فِي النّفَقَةِ وَ الكِسوَةِ
titles.en: 147- Chapter on Giving Some Wives Preference Over Others in Maintenance and Clothing

titles.ar: 148- بَابُ القِسمَةِ بَينَ الأَزوَاجِ
titles.en: 148- Chapter on the Distribution of Time Among Wives

titles.ar: 149- بَابُ إِتيَانِ النّسَاءِ فِيمَا دُونَ الفَرجِ
titles.en: 149- Chapter on Intercourse with Women Short of Full Penetration

titles.ar: 150- بَابُ حُكمِ المَحدُودَةِ
titles.en: 150- Chapter on the Ruling of a Woman Who Has Been Given a Hadd Punishment

titles.ar: 151- بَابُ العُيُوبِ المُوجِبَةِ لِلرّدّ فِي عَقدِ النّكَاحِ
titles.en: 151- Chapter on the Defects That Entitle a Party to Annul a Marriage Contract

titles.ar: 152- بَابُ العِنّينِ وَ أَحكَامِهِ
titles.en: 152- Chapter on Impotence and Its Rulings

titles.ar: 153- بَابُ أَنّ الرّجُلَ وَ المَرأَةَ إِذَا اختَلَفَا فِي ادّعَاءِ العُنّةِ عَلَيهِ
titles.en: 153- Chapter on a Man and Woman Who Disagree in a Claim of Impotence Against Him

titles.ar: 154- بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ دُخُولِ الخصَيِ ّ عَلَي النّسَاءِ
titles.en: 154- Chapter on the Dislikedness of a Eunuch Entering Upon Women

titles.ar: 155- بَابُ مُدّةِ الإِيلَاءِ التّيِ يُوقَفُ بَعدَهَا
titles.en: 155- Chapter on the Duration of Ila After Which the Husband Is Presented with a Choice

titles.ar: 156- بَابُ أَنّ المؤُليِ َ إِذَا أُلزِمَ الطّلَاقَ كَانَت تَطلِيقَةً رَجعِيّةً
titles.en: 156- Chapter That When a Muli (One Who Takes an Oath of Sexual Abstinence) Is Compelled to Divorce, It Is a Revocable Divorce

titles.ar: 157- بَابُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَي المؤُليِ إِذَا أُلزِمَ الطّلَاقَ فَأَبَي
titles.en: 157- Chapter on What Is Required of a Muli Who Is Compelled to Divorce and Refuses

titles.ar: 158- بَابُ أَنّهُ لَا يَصِحّ الظّهَارُ بِيَمِينٍ
titles.en: 158- Chapter That Zihar Is Not Valid When Accompanied by an Oath

titles.ar: 59- بَابُ حُكمِ الرّجُلِ يُظَاهِرُ مِنِ امرَأَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مَرّاتٍ كَثِيرَةً
titles.en: 59- Chapter on the Ruling of a Man Who Performs Zihar from One Wife Multiple Times

titles.ar: 160- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا ظَاهَرَ الرّجُلُ مِن نِسَائِهِ جَمَاعَةً بِلَفظٍ وَاحِدٍ مَا ألّذِي عَلَيهِ مِنَ الكَفّارَةِ
titles.en: 160- Chapter on a Man Who Performs Zihar from Multiple Wives with a Single Statement: What Expiation Is Required

titles.ar: 161- بَابُ أَنّ الظّهَارَ يَقَعُ بِالحُرّةِ وَ المَملُوكَةِ
titles.en: 161- Chapter That Zihar Applies to Both Free Women and Slave-Women

titles.ar: 162- بَابُ أَنّ مَن وَطِئَ قَبلَ الكَفّارَةِ كَانَ عَلَيهِ كَفّارَتَانِ
titles.en: 162- Chapter That One Who Has Intercourse Before the Expiation Owes Two Expiations

titles.ar: 163- بَابُ أَنّ مَن وَجَبَ عَلَيهِ العِتقُ فِي كَفّارَةِ الظّهَارِ فَصَامَ أَيّاماً ثُمّ وَجَدَ العِتقَ هَل يَلزَمُهُ العِتقُ أَم لَا
titles.en: 163- Chapter on One Who Is Required to Emancipate a Slave as Expiation for Zihar but Fasts Instead, Then Later Finds a Slave to Emancipate: Must He Emancipate

titles.ar: 164- بَابُ أَنّ مَن طَلّقَ امرَأَةً ثَلَاثَ تَطلِيقَاتٍ لِلسّنّةِ لَا تَحِلّ لَهُ حَتّي تَنكِحَ زَوجاً غَيرَهُ
titles.en: 164- Chapter That One Who Divorces His Wife with Three Pronouncements in Accordance with the Sunna May Not Remarry Her Until She Has Married Another Husband

titles.ar: 165- بَابُ مَا بِهِ تَقَعُ الفُرقَةُ مِن كِنَايَاتِ الطّلَاقِ

titles.en: 169- Chapter That If a Man Pronounces Three Divorces with All Conditions Fulfilled in a Single Session, Only One Takes Effect

titles.ar: 170- بَابُ أَنّ المُخَالِفَ إِذَا طَلّقَ امرَأَتَهُ ثَلَاثاً وَ إِن لَم يَستَوفِ شَرَائِطَ الطّلَاقِ كَانَ ذَلِكَ وَاقِعاً
titles.en: 170- Chapter That When a Sunni Opponent Divorces His Wife Three Times, Even If He Does Not Fulfill the Conditions of Divorce, It Is Considered Effective

titles.ar: 191- بَابُ أَنّ المُطَلّقَةَ الرّجعِيّةَ لَا يَجُوزُ لَهَا أَن تَخرُجَ إِلّا بِإِذنِ زَوجِهَا وَ لَا يَجُوزُ لَهُ إِخرَاجُهَا
titles.en: 191- Chapter That a Revocably Divorced Woman May Not Leave Her Home Without Her Husband's Permission, Nor May He Expel Her

titles.ar: 192- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا طَلّقَهَا التّطلِيقَةَ الثّالِثَةَ لَم يَكُن عَلَيهِ نَفَقَتُهَا وَ لَا سُكنَاهَا
titles.en: 192- Chapter That If He Divorces Her with the Third Pronouncement, He Owes Her No Maintenance or Housing

titles.en: 194- Chapter on the Waiting Period of a Slave-Woman Who Is Divorced and Then Emancipated

titles.en: 195- Chapter on the Waiting Period of a Woman Who Obtains a Khul' Divorce

titles.ar: 196- بَابُ أَنّ التّيِ لَم تَبلُغِ المَحِيضَ وَ الآئِسَةَ مِنهُ إِذَا كَانَتَا فِي سِنّ مَن لَا تَحِيضُ لَم يَكُن عَلَيهِمَا عِدّةٌ
titles.en: 196- Chapter That a Woman Who Has Not Reached Menstruation and One Who Is Past Menstruation and Both Are of the Age of Those Who Do Not Menstruate Have No Waiting Period

titles.en: 197- Chapter That a Woman Whose Husband Dies Before Consummating the Marriage Must Observe a Waiting Period

titles.ar: 198- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا سَمّي المَهرَ ثُمّ مَاتَ قَبلَ أَن يَدخُلَ بِهَا كَانَ عَلَيهِ المَهرُ كَامِلًا
titles.en: 198- Chapter That If the Mahr Is Named and the Husband Dies Before Consummation, He Owes the Full Mahr

titles.ar: 199- بَابُ أَنّ الرّجُلَ يُطَلّقُ امرَأَتَهُ ثُمّ يَمُوتُ قَبلَ أَن تَخرُجَ مِنَ العِدّةِ كَم يَلزَمُهَا مِنَ العِدّةِ
titles.en: 199- Chapter on a Man Who Divorces His Wife and Then Dies Before Her Waiting Period Expires: How Long Must She Wait

titles.ar: 200- بَابُ أَنّهُ لَا نَفَقَةَ لِلمُتَوَفّي عَنهَا زَوجُهَا فِي حَالِ عِدّتِهَا وَ إِن كَانَت حَامِلًا
titles.en: 200- Chapter That There Is No Maintenance for a Widow During Her Waiting Period Even If She Is Pregnant

titles.en: 204- Chapter That a Divorced Woman Is Not Required to Observe Mourning Dress

titles.ar: 205- بَابُ المُتَوَفّي عَنهَا زَوجُهَا هَل يَجُوزُ لَهَا أَن تَبِيتَ عَن مَنزِلِهَا أَم لَا
titles.en: 205- Chapter on Whether a Widow May Spend the Night Away from Her Home During Her Waiting Period

titles.ar: 206- بَابُ أَنّ الغَائِبَ إِذَا طَلّقَ امرَأَتَهُ اعتَدّت مِن يَومِ طَلّقَهَا لَا مِن يَومِ يَبلُغُهَا
titles.en: 206- Chapter That the Absent Husband's Divorce Takes Effect from the Day He Pronounced It, Not from the Day She Learns of It

titles.ar: 207- بَابُ أَنّهُ إِذَا مَاتَ الرّجُلُ غَائِباً عَن زَوجَتِهِ كَانَ عَلَيهَا العِدّةُ مِن يَومِ يَبلُغُهَا
titles.en: 207- Chapter That if a Man Dies While Absent from His Wife, She Observes Her Waiting Period from the Day She Receives the News

titles.ar: 208- بَابُ أَنّ العِدّةَ وَ الحَيضَ إِلَي النّسَاءِ وَ يُقبَلُ قَولُهُنّ فِيهِ
titles.en: 208- Chapter That Waiting Periods and Menstruation Are Determined by Women and Their Word Is Accepted in This

titles.ar: 209- بَابُ مَنِ اشتَرَي جَارِيَةً لَم تَبلُغِ المَحِيضَ لَم يَكُن عَلَيهِ استِبرَاؤُهَا
titles.en: 209- Chapter on One Who Purchases a Slave-Girl Who Has Not Reached Menstruation: He Need Not Verify Her Freedom from Prior Pregnancy

titles.ar: 210- بَابُ أَنّ مَنِ اشتَرَي جَارِيَةً وَ وَثِقَ بِصَاحِبِهَا فِي أَنّهُ استَبرَأَهَا لَم يَكُن عَلَيهِ استِبرَاءٌ
titles.en: 210- Chapter That One Who Purchases a Slave-Girl and Trusts the Seller's Word That He Has Verified Her Freedom from Prior Pregnancy Is Not Required to Verify Again

titles.ar: 211- بَابُ أَنّ مَنِ اشتَرَي مِنِ امرَأَةٍ جَارِيَةً ذَكَرَت أَنّهُ لَم يَطَأهَا أَحَدٌ لَم يَجِبِ استِبرَاؤُهَا
titles.en: 211- Chapter That One Who Purchases a Slave-Girl from a Woman Who States That No One Has Had Intercourse with Her Need Not Verify Her Freedom from Prior Pregnancy

titles.ar: 212- بَابُ مَنِ اشتَرَي جَارِيَةً فَأَعتَقَهَا فِي الحَالِ هَل يَجُوزُ لَهُ وَطؤُهَا قَبلَ أَن يَستَبرِئَهَا أَم لَا
titles.en: 212- Chapter on One Who Purchases a Slave-Girl and Immediately Emancipates Her: May He Have Intercourse with Her Before Verifying Her Freedom from Prior Pregnancy

titles.ar: 213- بَابُ أَنّ الرّجُلَ إِذَا اشتَرَي جَارِيَةً حُبلَي لَم يَجُز لَهُ وَطؤُهَا فِي الفَرجِ وَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ فِيمَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ
titles.en: 213- Chapter That a Man Who Purchases a Pregnant Slave-Girl May Not Have Vaginal Intercourse with Her, Though Other Intimacy Is Permitted

titles.ar: 214- بَابُ الرّجُلِ تَكُونُ لَهُ الجَارِيَةُ يَطَؤُهَا وَ يَطَؤُهَا غَيرُهُ سِفَاحاً وَ جَاءَت بِوَلَدٍ بِمَن يُلحَقُ
titles.en: 214- Chapter on a Man Who Has a Slave-Girl He Has Intercourse with and Another Man Also Has Illicit Intercourse with Her and She Gives Birth: To Whom Is the Child Attributed

titles.ar: 215- بَابُ القَومِ يَتَبَايَعُونَ الجَارِيَةَ فَوَطِئُوهَا فِي طُهرٍ وَاحِدٍ فَجَاءَت بِوَلَدٍ لِمَن يَكُونُ الوَلَدُ
titles.en: 215- Chapter on a Group of People Who Buy a Slave-Girl and All Have Intercourse with Her in a Single Period of Purity and She Gives Birth: To Whom Does the Child Belong

titles.ar: 216- بَابُ أَنّ اللّعَانَ يَثبُتُ بِادّعَاءِ الفُجُورِ وَ إِن لَم يَنفِ الوَلَدَ
titles.en: 216- Chapter That Li'an Is Established by Accusing of Adultery Even Without Denial of the Child

titles.ar: 217- بَابُ أَنّ اللّعَانَ يَثبُتُ بَينَ الحُرّ وَ المَملُوكَةِ وَ الحُرّةِ وَ المَملُوكِ
titles.en: 217- Chapter That Li'an Is Established Between a Free Man and a Slave-Woman and Between a Free Woman and a Male Slave

titles.ar: 218- بَابُ أَنّ اللّعَانَ يَثبُتُ مَعَ الحُبلَي
titles.en: 218- Chapter That Li'an Is Established When the Wife Is Pregnant

titles.ar: 219- بَابُ المُلَاعِنِ إِذَا أَقَرّ بِالوَلَدِ بَعدَ مضُيِ ّ اللّعَانِ
titles.en: 219- Chapter on the Mula'in (One Who Invokes Li'an) Who Acknowledges the Child After the Li'an Has Been Completed

titles.ar: 220- بَابُ الرّجُلِ يَقُولُ لِامرَأَتِهِ لَم أَجِدكِ عَذرَاءَ
titles.en: 220- Chapter on a Man Who Tells His Wife He Did Not Find Her a Virgin
